{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 — 原生 Windows 桌面壳（无边框窗口 / 系统托盘 / 原生通知 / 单实例 / 开机自启）| Native Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (frameless window, tray, native notifications, single-instance, auto-launch)","id":"gh:1333261846","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-desktop","slug":"SnowCrescenter-tech/dsh-desktop","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","desktop","dsh","dsh-plugin","electron","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 — 原生 Windows 桌面壳（无边框窗口 / 系统托盘 / 原生通知 / 单实例 / 开机自启）| Native Windows desktop shel"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"l for DeepSeek Harness (frameless window, tray, native notifications, single-instance, auto-launch)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-desktop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"🇨🇳 中文 · 🇬🇧 English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 一键原生桌面客户端，双击就能用上 DeepSeek Harness。不用装 Node，不用敲命令，安装完成，打开就是一个窗口。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 无边框窗口 · 系统托盘 · 原生通知 · 单实例运行。DeepSeek Harness 的全部能力，零搭建成本。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### 项目简介"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek 官方的 agent 框架。官方目前还是开发者预览版，自己动手装的话，得先装 Node 22.19+ 或 Node 24、装好 pnpm，再对着命"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"令行敲一串命令。对大多数非技术用户来说，这道门槛实在太高了。"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"dsh-desktop 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 包进一个原生 Windows 桌面程序。界面本身完全不动，只是外面多了一层顺手的壳：程序常驻系统托盘，窗口用自绘标题栏，"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"消息走 Windows 原生通知，同一时间只跑一个实例。下载、安装、双击，完事。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 功能一览"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 功能 | 一句话说明 |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| 无边框窗口 | 自绘 36px 标题栏 + 实时状态点 |
| 系统托盘 | 常驻后台，单击唤回，右键菜单齐全 |
| 原生通知 | 标准 Windows 通知样式，原生缺失时降级为托盘气泡 |
"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"| 单实例运行 | 同时只跑一个，重复双击唤出已有窗口 |
| 开机自启 | 可选，登录后在后台静默启动 |
| 首次引导 | 首启粘贴 API Key，即贴即用，Key 只存本机 |
| 端口 0 "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"自动分配 | 每次启动自动挑空闲端口，永不冲突 |
| 自动更新 | 后台静默下载，重启即完成更新 |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 功能特性"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `▭` **无边框窗口**：没有系统默认边框，36px 标题栏由程序自绘，并带一个实时状态点。青色 = 本地服务运行中，灰色 = 启动中，红色 = 出错了。Windows 11 下窗口圆角由 DW"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"M 原生渲染。
- `▣` **系统托盘**：程序常驻托盘。单击图标唤回主窗口；右键菜单包含：打开主界面、开机自启（复选）、关于、退出。
- `◈` **原生通知**：提醒走 Windows 原生通知"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"样式，和普通应用一模一样；系统不支持时自动降级为托盘气泡。
- `◎` **单实例运行**：同一时间只允许一个实例，重复双击只会把已有窗口唤到前台。
- `↻` **开机自启**：可选，登录后在后台自"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"动启动，由 Windows 注册表 Run 键实现。
- `▤` **首次启动引导**：第一次运行弹出一个向导对话框，引导你输入 DeepSeek API Key。Key 只保存在这台电脑上，位置是 "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"`<DSH_HOME>/.env`。
- `⇄` **端口 0 自动分配**：每次启动都让系统挑一个空闲端口（`--port 0`），天然不会和 3080 或其他程序撞车。
- `↑` **自动更新*"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"*：安装版（NSIS）启动后会在后台静默检查新版本并自动下载；下载就绪后弹原生通知，托盘菜单出现"重启并更新"，点击即重启应用完成安装。便携版没有安装器，"检查更新"会打开 GitHub Releas"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"es 页面，由你自行下载新版 zip 替换旧目录。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 架构一览"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"dsh-desktop 是一个 Electron 外壳。主进程负责窗口、托盘、通知、开机自启，以及启动并守护捆绑的 DeepSeek Harness CLI 的运行时监督器；preload 桥把一份精"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"简且冻结的 `window.dshDesktop` API 暴露给渲染层；窗口自身的 web 内容绘制标题栏，其下方一个沙箱化的 WebContentsView 承载 DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" 的 Web UI；这套 Web UI 跑在 `desktop` profile 上，按序装载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 和"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" `@dsh-desktop/client`。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### What is this?"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek's official agent framework. The official build is still a developer pre"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"view: setting it up by hand means installing Node 22.19+ or Node 24, pnpm, and a stack of command li"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ne steps. That is a high bar for most people."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"dsh-desktop wraps the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in a native Windows desktop app. The interface itself "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"is untouched, it just gets a friendlier shell: the app lives in the system tray, the window has its "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"own drawn title bar, notifications use the standard Windows style, and only one instance can run at "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"a time. Download, install, double-click, done."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `▭` **Frameless window**: no system frame. The 36px title bar is drawn by the app and carries a li"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ve status dot: teal while the local service runs, grey while it starts, red when something fails. On"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" Windows 11 the corners come from DWM, natively.
- `▣` **System tray**: the app stays in the tray. S"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ingle-click brings the window back; right-click opens the menu: open main window, start on boot (che"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ckbox), about, exit.
- `◈` **Native notifications**: alerts use the standard Windows notification st"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"yle, like any normal app, with a tray-balloon fallback where native support is missing.
- `◎` **Sing"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"le instance**: one copy at a time. A second double-click just brings the existing window to the fron"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"t.
- `↻` **Start on boot**: optionally launch in the background after sign-in, backed by a Windows r"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"egistry Run key.
- `▤` **First-run onboarding**: the first launch shows a guided dialog that asks fo"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"r your DeepSeek API key. The key is saved only on this machine, in `<DSH_HOME>/.env`.
- `⇄` **Port 0"},{"id":"p20s11","text":" auto-assign**: the service asks Windows for a free port on every launch (`--port 0`), so it never c"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"ollides with port 3080 or any other program.
- `↑` **Auto-update**: the installed (NSIS) build silen"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"tly checks for a new version shortly after launch and downloads it in the background. When it is rea"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"dy, a native notification appears and the tray menu shows "Restart and update"; pick it to restart a"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"nd apply. The portable zip has no installer, so its "Check for updates" opens the GitHub Releases pa"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"he portable zip has no installer, so its "Check for updates" opens the GitHub Releases page instead."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### First run: what happens under the hood"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The first launch is an orchestrated sequence. If no API key is configured, a modal dialog asks for o"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ne. The profile is written to disk, the bundled CLI is spawned with `--profile desktop --port 0`, an"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"d the supervisor waits for the ready line (`dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:<port>`). Once parsed, the Web"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" UI is loaded into the content view and the status dot turns teal."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. Acquire the single-instance lock. A second launch just brings the existing window to the front.
